thread:
sam.design: Pushed a tiny update to the prompt-sets triage toolbar prototype. Trying a compact metadata row above diffs instead of the sidebar. Thoughts?

maria.pm: link?

sam.design: https://redwood/intern/prototypes/triage-toolbar v2 (see comments). idea is quick context (prompt, run id, tags, tiny token delta) then the diff.

alex.research: i like the token delta in the header. makes triage faster when skimming many failures. can it be computed client-side if api doesn't include it?

devon.frontend: yes, we can compute a simple token-count diff as fallback. perf should be OK. main implementation bits: keep j/k navigation, avoid layout shifts when diff images load, and ensure the metadata row stays sticky within the diff pane.

li.accessibility: a11y notes: add aria-live region that announces "Showing diff for <prompt name>, tokens changed: +N" when selection changes; ensure the metadata row has proper headings. Also do not rely on color for status badges.

maria.pm: on wording: current CTAs read "Approve change" / "Reject". Legal flagged "Reject" as too strong. suggestions?

alex.research: prefer domain-specific verbs: "Mark expected" / "Mark regression". explicit for reporters.

sam.design: same. shorter primary label helps narrow panes. also include microcopy tooltip: "Mark expected — change matches desired behavior."

devon.frontend: will switch copy and add tooltip. keyboard shortcuts: m = mark expected, r = mark regression, shift+m = bulk mark visible. will add aria-pressed on buttons. sample markup I'll use: 

<button aria-pressed=\"false\" aria-label=\"Mark expected\" class=\"btn-primary\">Mark expected</button>
<button aria-pressed=\"false\" aria-label=\"Mark regression\" class=\"btn-secondary\">Mark regression</button>

li.accessibility: good. also ensure focus ring is visible on Mac Safari: recommend fallback outline of 3px solid Highlight or #005fcc and high-contrast tooltip backgrounds (WCAG 4.5:1 min).

maria.pm: also want a tiny inline confirmation for accidental marks (toast with undo) rather than modal. keeps flow fast.

devon.frontend: will add toast with 5s undo. edge case: bulk actions should show a small confirm overlay when > 50 items.

qa-bot: Automated run 3487 finished 024-11-02: 12 regressions found. Added to "Prompt Eval" board.

sam.design: open question about default layout: keep list-left/diff-right but allow flip via user prefs? or default to diff-first for regression-heavy teams?

alex.research: default list-left keeps metadata visible for casual reviewers. put flip in prefs and a toolbar toggle so power users can switch per-session.

maria.pm: agreed. make preference per-team as well for Dedicated customers who run large triage squads.

devon.frontend: action items: 1) implement compact metadata row (sticky) + token delta, 2) update CTA copy to "Mark expected" / "Mark regression" + tooltip, 3) aria-live announcement + aria-pressed on buttons, 4) visible focus ring fallback, 5) toast undo and bulk confirm. aiming to open PR by Fri EOD with screenshots and keyboard test notes.

li.accessibility: i'll add a short test plan for SR users and validate with NVDA/VoiceOver on the PR.

maria.pm: perfect. sam, i'll follow up with copy for the tooltip and the small team-pref language for settings.

sam.design: thanks everyone. leaving a couple pixel nits in the prototype about spacing between the meta row and diff header. ping when PR is ready for review :thumbsup:
